canonical_log_hash: SHA256 of the episode JSONL after removing only runner_pid.
decision_rule: If row and canonical episode-log hashes are identical across repeats, single-rollout stochastic/numerical repeatability is not a plausible explanation for the weak cross-terrain J_stability/J_energy transfer observed in T6.4. If exact repeats differ, quantify runtime/contact nondeterminism before modifying the Objective Selector.
seed_semantics: The same episode seed is propagated to the terrain-seeded PyMPC runner; terrain geometry is therefore held exactly fixed across repeats.
